comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
To date, the book itself remains unreleased. The following items have been released as bottle drops:

English Naval Petty Officer Uniform
Abito da Virago
Pioneers Shirt

I had hopes for this book being released someday, but with three of its outfits having been available in the Sailor Bottles, I suspect it may never be (would love to be wrong!). I do hope the remaining outfits will be made available, at least.
